item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello! It's the Double Ninth Festival, a day to care for grandparents. Here is your weather report for Sunday, October 18. It's Sunday, a good day to rest and get ready for the week. Here in Shanghai, the day will be drizzly. The high will be 33 degrees, and the low will be 23 degrees. Properly hot today, the kind that makes you seek out shade. Rain is about 73 percent likely today. There are 13 days to go until a special day. Can you guess which one? Don't forget your umbrella today! And here's a look ahead: tomorrow will be drizzly, with a high of 26 degrees. Something to think about: what colour is today, do you think? And that's the weather. Have a brilliant day!
